title: Variational Parameter Calibration with Physics-Aware Latent-Space Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2608.11435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forward and inverse modeling of parametric dynamical systems requires surrogate models that are not only accurate for state prediction, but also informative for parameter calibration. However, a systematic end-to-end differentiable formulation for coupling deep-learning-based reduced-order surrogates with variational parameter estimation remains underdeveloped. In this work, we introduce a physics-aware neural-network-based latent-space framework for reduced-order forward modeling and variational parameter estimation. The proposed autoencoder-based approach yields a differentiable surrogate that maps physical parameters to predicted flow fields through a latent representation. translated_title: 基于物理感知潜空间代理的变分参数校准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11435v1 公告类型：新 摘要：参数动力系统的正演和反演建模需要代理模型，这些模型不仅要对状态预测准确，还要对参数校准提供信息。然而，将基于深度学习的降阶代理与变分参数估计耦合的系统性端到端可微公式仍待发展。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个基于物理感知神经网络的潜空间框架，用于降阶正演建模和变分参数估计。所提出的基于自编码器的方法产生了一个可微代理，该代理通过潜表示将物理参数映射到预测的流场。离线训练期间使用可观测监督来鼓励潜变量保留与系统参数相关的信息，而在线反问题则通过代理诱导的观测算子参数空间求解。
tldr: 本文提出了一种物理感知的潜空间代理框架，通过自编码器实现可微降阶建模，并利用变分方法在参数空间中进行高效校准，从而解决了深度学习降阶代理与参数估计耦合不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a physics-aware latent-space surrogate framework that enables differentiable reduced-order modeling via autoencoders and variational parameter calibration, addressing the gap in coupling deep-learning surrogates with parameter estimation.
